scope: Rotor shell as one connected solid, following the manufacturer arrangement (spoked shell carrying the magnets on its rim, sun force-fitted into the hub).
status: Primeform proposal: not OEM or CubeMars geometry. Sizing is measured from the source housing bore, the hub flange and the stator position.

features.spoked_web: r 22.25 to 40.5 mm, z 0.25 to 2.25 mm, 6 ribs of 4.0 mm
features.magnet_rim: r 40.5 to 42.4 mm, z -2.5 to 11.25 mm, magnets bonded on the 81.0 mm bore
features.closing_flange: r 40.5 to 42.4 mm, z -2.5 to -1.0 mm, closing the rear of the magnet band

open: The joint to the hub is undefined: no fit, key, screw or bond is specified.
The magnet radial band (r 40.5 to 42.5 mm) does not match the arcuate slots in the source housings (r 41.766 to 43.236 mm), so rotor radial placement is unproven.
